en_US: I’ve spent my whole life studying
the Solaceon Ruins.
They say the Unown there can sense
the Pokémon a Trainer has lost.
Its shape takes after the burden
that Trainer carries.
One followed me home, and I think
it was looking for you.
Will you take it with you?
They say no one has ever seen
a Pokémon actually lay an Egg.
So, it hasn’t been proven that
Pokémon actually lay Eggs.
Oh, how wonderful.
Take good care of it, dear.
Would you like to give a nickname
to the {STRVAR_1 0, 1, 0} you received?
Oh, but you already have a whole
team of Pokémon with you.
Make some room, then come and
see me again.
I see...
It will wait here for you.
Every Unown is shaped by the
Trainer it finds.
Cherish the Pokémon that are
still by your side.
